---
title: "StartupTrace"
---

## Overview

`StartupTrace` emits `[Startup]`-tagged `spdlog::debug` messages to diagnose crash-recovery and layout-timing issues during application startup.

## Usage

Run Neuralyzer with debug logging enabled:

```bash
WhiskerToolbox --debug 2>&1 | tee startup_debug.log
grep '\[Startup\]' startup_debug.log
```

## Key signals

| Log pattern | Meaning |
|-------------|---------|
| `recovery_dialog_open=true` on `splitter_state` | Splitter sizing ran during the recovery prompt (suspect) |
| `zero splitter dimension detected` | `applySplitterSizes` ran before the window had valid geometry |
| `after w.show()` with `visible=false` | Main window failed to appear after startup |

## Related

- Crash recovery flow: `MainWindow::_checkCrashRecovery()` (deferred until after `w.show()`)
- Deferred splitter sizing: `MainWindow::_finishStartupLayout()` / `ZoneManager::reapplySplitterSizes()`
